title: machaerium acutifolium var. pseudacutifolium
intro: Machaerium acutifolium var. pseudacutifolium, commonly known as the "Palo Amarillo", is a plant species found in Central and South America. The Palo Amarillo has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation, thus exhibiting therapeutic actions as a vasodilator and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of the Palo Amarillo include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Additionally, the plant has been used to treat digestive issues and respiratory problems due to its expectorant and spasmolytic properties.
